cards.algorithm_en: Inventory actual same-asset Few observations and historical evidence. Require valid fact times, coverage and configured freshness/invalidation rules. Reading now does not make cached facts current. Separate empty, incomplete and failed reads; schema declarations are not collected records. Preserve useful traceable evidence and explicit gaps.

cards.description_zh: 从近约1–4周的真实讨论提炼3–5个具体问题，每题附证明讨论存在的原始链接。
cards.algorithm_zh: 查看近约1–4周的X帖子搜索、新闻搜索、新闻网站、论坛、交易所公告和项目官网/文档/官方X/公告频道。先听市场再决定页面问题，产出3–5个交易者真实在问的具体问题或争议，逐题保存讨论来源链接、发布时间及搜索覆盖。过滤同名词的无关用法、纯喊单和推广；这些只能用于寻找原始来源，不能当事实。搜索摘要只是线索。请求克制、留足间隔；遇429按可用Retry-After退避，受限时记录缺口，不通过高频重试补足数量。找不到足够有来源的问题则needs_review，不虚构凑数。section_plan以问题为主线，不预先套通用模板。
decision_rules_zh: 版块顺序由证据决定；类型分类本身也应有出处。
事件内容和风险结论未经证据支持只能标待核查，不采用试跑摘要作为事实。

cards.algorithm_en: Search roughly the last 1–4 weeks of X posts and news, news sites, forums, exchange notices and official project sites, docs, X and announcement channels. Produce 3–5 specific questions traders actually ask, each with original discussion links, publication times and coverage. Exclude unrelated names, shilling and promotional posts as evidence; use them only to locate originals. Search snippets are leads. Space requests; on 429 back off using Retry-After when available and record gaps. Insufficient sourced questions means needs_review, never invented questions. Plan around questions, without a fixed template.

cards.description_zh: 逐题确定能回答问题的数据、口径、免费无密钥来源及第二核对来源。
cards.algorithm_zh: 先为每个问题写出所需指标、事实口径、时间范围、来源与第二核对来源，再交取数卡执行。只用免费且无需密钥或付费访问的官方文档、区块浏览器、链官方RPC、CoinGecko免账号接口、data-api.binance.vision、DEX Screener、DefiLlama等公开接口及交易所公告。可复用符合身份/时点/覆盖要求且来源可追溯的FU资料，不重复抓取；内部资料不绕过公开来源可核查要求。不可访问、验证拦截、限流或平台不公开的数据记为无法核实及原因，不估算、不编造，不自动申请权限或付费。
decision_rules_zh: 不重复抓取已经合格的当前内部观测。
不自动配置权限、付费访问或部署；来源不可达不伪造成已获取。

cards.algorithm_en: For each question specify metrics, definitions, period, a free keyless source and a second verification source before fetching. Use official docs, explorers, official chain RPC, keyless CoinGecko, data-api.binance.vision, DEX Screener, DefiLlama and public exchange notices. Record inaccessible, challenged, rate-limited or unpublished data as currently unverifiable with reasons; do not estimate, invent, buy access or request new permissions.

cards.description_zh: 按问题取数并留存证据和运行日志，每币维护贯穿三轮的独立研究记录。
cards.algorithm_zh: 输出 evidence_records 列表，保留合格内部证据并追加本次原始数据/必要摘录、出处、事实时间和内容哈希。混合响应按被引用的事实分类，避免为了分类重复请求。已过期基础资料核实失败时保留旧审计记录但不作为当前有效输入；记录缺口。此卡留存运行内证据，尚不写生产证据表。 按source_plan逐题取数，数字必须找到第二来源供交叉核对。保留请求结果、429等状态和退避记录、事实时点、采集时间、原始链接及必要原始响应；日志去除连接参数和密钥。每个代币一份独立research_record，持续记录问题、讨论来源链接、选用数据和来源、核对结果、无法核实项与原因、删掉内容及原因；第三轮补全最终取舍，自检确认完整。研究记录独立于严格页面JSON，不写入#1039；实际持久化位置由接入实现核验，不伪称已保存。
decision_rules_zh: evidence_id 在同一资产/来源/内容版本下唯一，不能只用日期防重。
retrieved_at 不替代 as_of/published_at；来源日期仅有日/月时保留原值及精度，不伪造精确时间。

cards.algorithm_en: Close round two by checking each intended number against a second source, matching asset, time, units, chain and metric. cards.algorithm_zh: 逐题组织页面：建议以“交易者在问什么”列出问题，接3–4项简短当前stats，再每题一个最适合的允许区块，标题就是问题，正文/caption给答案、数据、来源和局限；有明确日期才加接下来要看的日期，末尾风险与来源。顺序仅作参考，不套headline→stats→发生了什么等固定模板。不服务于问题的排名、FDV和长历史等删除，并在research_record记理由；十种区块表达不了的内容舍弃并记原因。只输出规范卡规定的严格v1 JSON，所有展示文字中英双语，assetKey为给定asset_id且展示文字无内部id。generatedAt使用制作当下精确到秒的带时区时间；每项事实保留自身时点和来源。完成research_record最终取舍；它不属于页面JSON字段。目标前端契约/校验器不可访问时标unconnected，不能声称可发布。

cards.algorithm_en: Write question → answer sections from verified evidence. Suggested order: what traders ask, 3–4 current stats, one suitable allowed block per question with the question as title and answer/data/sources/limits in body or caption, relevant upcoming dates if known, risks and sources. Order is guidance, not a universal template. Remove unrelated rankings, FDV and long histories. Log omissions, including content unsupported by the ten allowed blocks. Produce only strict v1 JSON with bilingual display text; assetKey equals the supplied asset_id, never shown in display text. generatedAt is the actual current time to seconds with a timezone; individual facts retain their own times. Finalize the independent research_record without adding it to page JSON. Missing target contract/validator means unconnected, not publishable.

cards.description_zh: 检查身份、证据、内容与目标前端兼容性；保留页面产物和运行上下文交给保存。

decision_rules_zh: 结构通过不等于事实正确；报告实际检查范围与未核实项。
试跑252项测试是原作者报告，不继承为本批通过。
检查失败不进入 save；超过一次格式修复仍失败则终止。

cards.algorithm_en: Use the target web/domain/token-page-script.ts zod validator at the same version. page_rules.text_zh: 顶层仅version=1、symbol、assetKey（必须等于给定资产id）、title和headline（中英双语）、generatedAt（当前时间，精确到秒，带时区）、isSample=false、sources、blocks；不允许多余字段，所有数字有限，整份≤256KB。内部id不得出现在展示文字。
page_rules.text_en: Only version=1, symbol, assetKey (the supplied asset id), bilingual title/headline, generatedAt (actual current time, seconds and timezone), isSample=false, sources and blocks. No extra fields; finite numbers; total ≤256KB. Never display internal ids.

page_rules.text_zh: 仅text、stats、line_chart、bar_chart、table、timeline、comparison、quotes、callout、links。不能自创新块；表达不了就舍弃并记入研究记录。一般6–12块，最多40块。
page_rules.text_en: Only text, stats, line_chart, bar_chart, table, timeline, comparison, quotes, callout and links. Do not invent block types. Omit unsupported content with a reason in the research record. Usually 6–12 blocks, at most 40.

page_rules.text_zh: text 1–8段；stats 1–8项且value≤160字符；line_chart 2–120点、1–4条线；bar_chart 1–24柱；table 1–6列、1–30行；timeline 1–12事件；comparison 2–4列、每列1–8项；quotes 1–8条；callout items最多8项；links 1–10条。
page_rules.text_en: text: 1–8 paragraphs; stats: 1–8 items, value ≤160 characters; line_chart: 2–120 points, 1–4 series; bar_chart: 1–24 bars; table: 1–6 columns, 1–30 rows; timeline: 1–12 events; comparison: 2–4 columns, 1–8 items each; quotes: 1–8; callout: ≤8 items; links: 1–10.

page_rules.text_zh: sources最多12条，只放实际使用的http(s)链接。所有展示文字中英双语，每条事实附来源链接；无法核实的数字不写，问题说明“目前无法核实”及原因。不编造、不夸大、不喊单、不给买卖建议。
page_rules.text_en: At most 12 actually used http(s) sources. All display text is bilingual; every fact links to its evidence. Omit unverifiable numbers and explain why the question is currently unverifiable. No fabrication, exaggeration, shilling or buy/sell advice.

page_rules.text_zh: 第一轮近约1–4周真实讨论，3–5个具体问题逐题附原始讨论链接；同名噪音、喊单和推广只作查源线索。X帖子/新闻搜索留足间隔，429退避并记缺口。第二轮逐题确定数据，只用免费且无需密钥的官方文档、浏览器、官方RPC、CoinGecko免账号接口、data-api.binance.vision、DEX Screener、DefiLlama及公开公告。数字必须第二来源核对，差异注明并说明可靠来源取舍。
page_rules.text_en: Round one: roughly 1–4 weeks, 3–5 concrete questions with original discussion links; unrelated names and promotional posts are leads only. Space X post/news searches and back off on 429, recording gaps. Round two chooses data per question using only free keyless official docs, explorers, official RPC, keyless CoinGecko, data-api.binance.vision, DEX Screener, DefiLlama and public notices. Cross-check numbers against a second source; explain discrepancies and source selection.

page_rules.text_zh: 每币单独记录问题、讨论链接、选用数据及来源、核对结果、无法核实项及原因、删掉内容及原因（含十种区块无法表达的内容）。贯穿三轮并保留运行日志，独立于页面JSON与#1039。实际存储位置待接入核验。
page_rules.text_en: One record per token: questions, discussion links, selected data/sources, cross-checks, unknowns/reasons and omissions/reasons, including unsupported content. Maintain it across all three rounds with runtime logs, outside page JSON and #1039. Actual storage remains unconnected.

page_rules.text_zh: 必须用web/domain/token-page-script.ts的zod校验；校验与保存同一命令，失败不保存。仅200/201成功；409不重试；422全部修完再发；404/401/503停止；413缩短；502稍后重发。修改或重发前重新校验；只有确认成功才回写当前网页记录，失败保留旧页。
page_rules.text_en: Use zod from web/domain/token-page-script.ts. Validate and save in one command; failed validation prevents saving. Only 200/201 succeeds; 409 no retry; 422 fix all; 404/401/503 stop; 413 shorten; 502 resend later. Revalidate changed or resubmitted artifacts. Only confirmed success updates the current page row; preserve old success on failure.

page_rules.text_zh: 连接参数和密钥仅从服务器环境文件加载，绝不打印、记录或写入页面、卡片、研究记录。新页面一律三轮；已有页面重做等用户另定。保持原筛选、去重、成功回写、并发与旧结果保护；本规范仅引用，不启动执行。
page_rules.text_en: Load connection parameters and secrets only from server environment files; never print or store them in logs, pages, cards or research records. All new pages use three rounds; reworking existing pages awaits a separate user decision. Preserve selection, deduplication, confirmed writes, concurrency and stale-result protection. This card is a non-executing reference.

question_examples.question_zh: 项目网站关闭后代币还有什么用？
question_examples.answer_zh: 官方公告原文；comparison列“停止的/继续的”。
question_examples.question_en: What remains useful after the project website closes?
question_examples.answer_en: Original official notice; comparison of discontinued and continuing functions.

question_examples.answer_zh: 各交易所公告的理由/决定日期，加CoinGecko tickers计算所涉交易所占公开全网成交额比例，说明快照时点、覆盖和计算口径；table。
question_examples.answer_en: Exchange notices with reasons/dates, plus CoinGecko tickers to calculate affected venues’ share of reported global turnover. Explain snapshot, coverage and denominator; table.

question_examples.question_zh: 借贷产品里的贷款怎么办？
question_examples.answer_zh: DefiLlama该借贷协议TVL变化用line_chart；查不到未还贷款笔数就直说，TVL不能代替贷款笔数。
question_examples.question_en: What happens to loans in the lending product?
question_examples.answer_en: Use a line_chart of protocol TVL from DefiLlama. State when outstanding loan counts are unavailable; TVL is not a count of loans.

question_examples.answer_zh: DefiLlama手续费与协议收入；text，解释口径和局限，不以费用直接冒充代币持有人收益。
question_examples.question_en: What is the fee switch worth?
question_examples.answer_en: DefiLlama fees and protocol revenue; text with definitions and limits. Fees do not automatically accrue to token holders.

question_examples.answer_zh: data-api.binance.vision日K线成交额；bar_chart，注明“成交缩小不等于见底”。
question_examples.question_en: Has selling pressure eased after the crash?
question_examples.answer_en: Daily kline turnover from data-api.binance.vision; bar_chart, with “lower volume does not mean a bottom”.

question_examples.answer_zh: 链官方RPC读取销毁地址balanceOf，对照官方公布数字；stats，保留合约、地址和时点证据。
question_examples.answer_en: Read burn-address balanceOf through official chain RPC, compare with the official figure; stats with contract, address and time evidence.

question_examples.question_zh: 和同类项目的市值差距？
question_examples.answer_zh: CoinGecko两币市值；bar_chart，注明差距本身不说明谁被低估。
question_examples.question_en: How does its market cap compare with peers?
question_examples.answer_en: CoinGecko market caps for both tokens; bar_chart, noting the gap alone does not show undervaluation.

question_examples.answer_zh: 官方锁定文档加DEX Screener主池流动性与成交；table，区分文档声明与链上已核实事实。
question_examples.answer_en: Official locking documentation plus DEX Screener primary-pool liquidity and turnover; table, distinguishing documented claims from verified on-chain facts.

question_examples.answer_zh: 拿不到持有人排名则写“目前无法核实”和原因，只给可确认数据及局限。
question_examples.answer_en: If holder rankings are unavailable, say “Currently unverifiable” and why; present only confirmed data with its limits.
